sources.title: 2022 federal election — House of Representatives candidates (declared nominations)
sources.note: House of Representatives candidate set and ballot order for the 21 May 2022 poll (declaration of nominations). Columns StateAb, DivisionNm, CandidateNm, PartyNm, BallotPosition round-trip to ballots.json verbatim. This raw CSV is a byte-faithful, lossless export of the committed 2022 ballots.json, retained in-repo and pinned by SHA-256. It is a dated snapshot captured on 2026-07-18 — NOT an independent contemporaneous AEC download from 2022. From the 2025 election onward the AEC nominations feed is captured live at nomination time (see data/source/2025), giving a true point-in-time snapshot; 2019 and 2022 predate that practice, so these records honestly capture the dataset as we now hold it rather than the AEC record as it stood at the time. Rights: AEC candidate data (CC BY 4.0). The two-person ballot-ORDER review is tracked separately in ballot-verification.json.
